objective: Validate remote access lifeline before allowing Direct Internet Method and Tailscale simultaneous operation
interpretation: Both hosts can exchange authenticated Tailscale discovery and encrypted WireGuard TSMP data through DERP. A direct UDP path did not establish in bounded tests. Saeid destination-varying NAT and no detected port mapping are consistent with a relayed path; not a proof of unique causation. RustDesk direct-IP TCP 21118 is not listening/accessible on either host, so functional RustDesk desktop session over Tailscale is UNPROVEN. RustDesk may still work through its separate ID/relay system.
